plan.title: Senior Backend Engineer interview
plan.purpose: Explore candidate's experience and skills in building reliable backend payment systems and their approach to ownership and observability.

questions.question: Can you describe your role and key responsibilities as a Staff Engineer at Northwind Payments?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Listen for details about system scale, challenges faced, and specific contributions.
questions.evidence_quote: Led the redesign of the settlement ledger from a single Postgres database into an event-sourced service processing about 4 million transactions per day
questions.basis: Candidate's leadership in redesigning a core payment system aligns with senior backend engineer responsibilities.

questions.question: You introduced idempotency keys across all write APIs at Northwind Payments. Can you explain why idempotency is important and how you implemented it?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Probe for technical approach, challenges, and impact on system reliability.
questions.evidence_quote: Introduced idempotency keys across all write APIs, which removed a class of double-charge incidents
questions.basis: Directly relates to job requirement for designing reliable, idempotent APIs.

questions.question: What strategies did you use to reduce the p99 settlement latency from 2.4 seconds to 700 milliseconds?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Seek details on architectural changes, trade-offs, and monitoring methods.
questions.evidence_quote: Reduced p99 settlement latency from 2.4 seconds to 700 milliseconds by moving reconciliation to batched consumers on Kafka
questions.basis: Performance tuning experience with asynchronous workflows and message queues is relevant to the role.

questions.question: How have you approached mentoring engineers and managing on-call rotations in your recent roles?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Explore mentoring style, incident handling, and team communication practices.
questions.evidence_quote: Mentored five engineers and ran the on-call rotation for a team of eight
questions.basis: Mentorship and incident response leadership are key responsibilities in the job description.

questions.question: Can you discuss your experience designing the database sharding strategy for the orders table at Brightloop Commerce?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Listen for reasoning behind sharding choices and impact on scalability and reliability.
questions.evidence_quote: Designed the database sharding strategy for the orders table
questions.basis: Relevant to improving data modeling and performance in PostgreSQL as required by the role.

questions.question: What approaches have you used to improve observability and lead post-incident improvements in backend systems?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Probe for tools, metrics, communication, and learning from incidents.
questions.basis: Observability and incident response are critical for the payments platform role.

plan.interviewer_style: Calm, concise, and curious, encouraging detailed explanations and reflections without pressure.
plan.closing_instructions: Thank the candidate warmly for their time and insights, without mentioning next steps, feedback, or outcomes.

revision.request: Replace the last question with one about handling disagreement with a colleague.
revision.last_question_before: What approaches have you used to improve observability and lead post-incident improvements in backend systems?
revision.last_question_after: Can you describe a time when you disagreed with a colleague on a technical decision? How did you handle the situation?

plan.title: AI Engineer Interview
plan.purpose: Explore candidate's experience and skills in building and evaluating LLM-powered retrieval systems with a focus on quality and safety.

questions.question: Can you describe your role and main responsibilities at Halcyon Health related to LLM-based retrieval systems?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Listen for specifics about system design, challenges faced, and their role in the project.
questions.evidence_quote: Built a retrieval-augmented question answering system over internal clinical guidelines for nurses
questions.basis: Candidate's direct experience with retrieval-augmented systems relevant to job requirements.

questions.question: How did you design and use the evaluation harness with 600 hand-labelled questions to measure system quality?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Probe for methods of evaluation, metrics used, and how results influenced improvements.
questions.evidence_quote: Created an evaluation harness of 600 hand-labelled questions and used it to catch a regression
questions.basis: Candidate's experience in building evaluation systems aligns with job's quality measurement needs.

questions.question: You mentioned reducing unsupported answers from 14% to 3% by adding citation checks and a refusal path. Can you explain how you implemented these features?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Seek details on technical approach, challenges, and impact on user experience.
questions.evidence_quote: Reduced unsupported answers from 14 percent to 3 percent by adding citation checks and a refusal path
questions.basis: Directly relevant to job focus on reducing hallucinations and safe failure handling.

questions.question: What approach did you take to run A/B tests on prompt changes and write team guidance on prompt versioning?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Ask about experimental design, interpretation of results, and documentation practices.
questions.evidence_quote: Ran A/B tests on prompt changes and wrote the team guidance on prompt versioning
questions.basis: Experience with prompt engineering and evaluation relevant to job responsibilities.

questions.question: Can you discuss your experience developing Python applications and APIs, particularly any work involving FastAPI or Docker?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Look for examples of projects, challenges, and how these tools were used effectively.
questions.evidence_quote: Python, PyTorch, vector databases, evaluation design, prompt engineering, FastAPI, Docker
questions.basis: Candidate's listed skills relevant to job's technical requirements.

questions.question: How do you approach designing experiments and interpreting results to improve LLM-powered features?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Encourage candidate to describe methodology, metrics, and decision-making processes.
questions.basis: Key job requirement to design experiments and interpret results for feature improvement.

questions.question: Can you share your perspective on balancing automation with safety and privacy concerns in LLM applications?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Listen for examples or principles guiding safe and privacy-conscious automation decisions.
questions.basis: Job requires good judgment about safety, privacy, and when not to automate.

questions.question: How have you worked with product managers to define quality goals or 'what good looks like' for LLM features?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Probe for communication style, alignment processes, and examples of goal setting.
questions.basis: Job responsibility includes collaboration with product managers on quality definitions.

plan.interviewer_style: Calm, concise, and curious tone to encourage detailed and thoughtful responses without pressure.
plan.closing_instructions: Thank the candidate warmly for their time and insights. Avoid mentioning next steps, timelines, outcomes, feedback, or assessments.

plan.title: Logistics Operations Manager interview
plan.purpose: Explore candidate's experience and skills in managing logistics operations, focusing on staffing, carrier management, safety, and conflict resolution.

questions.question: Can you describe how you managed to reduce late deliveries at Andes Distribution and what challenges you faced during that process?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Listen for details on specific steps taken, challenges encountered, and how improvements were measured and sustained.
questions.evidence_quote: Cut late deliveries from 9 percent to 4 percent by reorganising dock scheduling and introducing a daily cross-site planning call
questions.basis: Candidate's claim of improving delivery timeliness aligns with job requirement for operations leadership and performance management.

questions.question: Tell me about your experience negotiating carrier contracts and how you handled underperforming carriers.
questions.follow_up_guidance: Probe for negotiation strategies, criteria for assessing carrier performance, and outcomes of renegotiations.
questions.evidence_quote: Negotiated carrier contracts and renegotiated two that were underperforming
questions.basis: Candidate's experience with carrier management directly relates to job responsibility of managing carrier relationships and service performance.

questions.topic: Safety culture and staffing during peak seasons
questions.question: How did you lead the peak-season hiring and training plan while maintaining safety standards?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Seek specifics on training approaches, safety measures, and how safety incidents were monitored and prevented.
questions.evidence_quote: Led a peak-season hiring and training plan that added 35 seasonal workers without increasing safety incidents
questions.basis: Candidate's role in staffing and safety during peak periods is critical to job's focus on safety culture and staffing planning.

questions.question: Can you share an example of a difficult people situation you managed and how you coached supervisors through it?
questions.follow_up_guidance: Look for examples of conflict resolution, fairness, communication style, and outcomes of coaching efforts.
questions.basis: Job requires coaching supervisors and handling difficult people situations fairly; no direct resume quote but important to assess interpersonal skills.

plan.interviewer_style: Warm, curious, and supportive tone to encourage detailed responses, especially on conflict and safety trade-offs under pressure.
plan.closing_instructions: Thank the candidate warmly for their time and insights. Avoid discussing next steps, timelines, outcomes, feedback, or assessments.
